import pytest

from numeric import integer_sqrt


def test_integer_sqrt_negative_raises_value_error():
    """Negative input must raise ValueError with exact message."""
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="n must be non-negative"):
        integer_sqrt(-1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="n must be non-negative"):
        integer_sqrt(-1000)


def test_integer_sqrt_zero_and_one():
    """Zero and one are handled as base cases."""
    assert integer_sqrt(0) == 0
    assert integer_sqrt(1) == 1


def test_integer_sqrt_two_and_three():
    """Small inputs 2 and 3 return 1."""
    assert integer_sqrt(2) == 1
    assert integer_sqrt(3) == 1


def test_integer_sqrt_perfect_square_100():
    """Perfect square 100 returns 10."""
    assert integer_sqrt(100) == 10


def test_integer_sqrt_non_perfect_square_99():
    """Non-perfect square 99 returns 9."""
    assert integer_sqrt(99) == 9


def test_integer_sqrt_large_input_1000000000():
    """Large input 10^9 returns 31622."""
    assert integer_sqrt(1000000000) == 31622  # floor(sqrt(10^9)) = 31622.776...

def test_leap_year_logic_branches():

    # Not divisible by 4 → False

    assert is_leap_year(2025) is False

import pytest

from containers import chunk


def test_chunk_single_element():
    assert chunk([42], 10) == [[42]]


def test_chunk_large_list():
    items = list(range(100))
    chunks = chunk(items, 10)
    assert len(chunks) == 10

    assert chunks[-1] == list(range(90, 100))

    items = list(range(1000))
    chunks = chunk(items, 1)
    assert len(chunks) == 1000
    assert chunks[0] == [0]
    assert chunks[-1] == [999]


def test_chunk_size_equal_to_length_large_list():
    items = list(range(100))
    chunks = chunk(items, 100)
    assert len(chunks) == 1
    assert chunks[0] == list(range(100))


def test_chunk_size_larger_than_length_large_list():
    items = list(range(50))
    chunks = chunk(items, 100)
    assert len(chunks) == 1
    assert chunks[0] == list(range(50))

from validators import validate_port


def test_port_all_valid_cases():
    valid_ports = [1, 1024, 2048, 443, 65535]
    for port in valid_ports:
        assert validate_port(port) == port


def test_port_invalid_bools():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port must be an integer"):
        validate_port(True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port must be an integer"):
        validate_port(False)


def test_port_invalid_ranges():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port out of range"):
        validate_port(-1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port out of range"):
        validate_port(0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port out of range"):
        validate_port(65536)


def test_port_invalid_types():
    for invalid_type in [1.0, "8080", None, [], {}]:
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            validate_port(invalid_type)


def test_port_exact_match_error_messages():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port must be an integer"):
        validate_port(True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port out of range"):
        validate_port(65536)
